notes.title: Leaderboard Patch
notes.content:
I sincerely apologize to everyone about the leaderboard crashes.

Change the way LeaderboardMenu textures are initialized, specifically the size of the vector that contains the LeaderboardMenu Entries textures
Change the range of a function call to download the leaderboard entries from [1,2] to [-1,1]

notes.title: Leaderboard Hotfix
notes.content: Leaderboard Hotfixs, The leaderboard formatting was off, and only displayed the top nine scores. The hotfix's intentions was to update the leaderboard formatting, and displays ten entries instead of nine. Feel free to send bug reports, and comments to sanzo.tonia@gmail.com.
